results.title: To All the Books
results.overview: Part rock star, part literary icon, Josh Malerman is a creative force of nature. From penning the global sensation “Bird Box” (later adapted into the smash-hit Netflix movie starring Sandra Bullock) to writing the theme song for the Emmy-winning series “Shameless” and touring the world with his band, his life is as unpredictable and thrilling as one of his novels. But behind every writer’s success is the haunting presence of the blank page.  TO ALL THE BOOKS invites you to ride shotgun with Malerman as he wrestles with the creative process of his next novel, offering a rare, behind-the-scenes look at the highs, lows, and beautiful chaos of artistic life. Brimming with raw honesty and unfiltered passion, this fly-on-the-wall documentary is a must-see for readers, writers, and dreamers alike.

results.title: Little Star
results.overview: A man haunted by his past is led on a surreal, dark journey through the night, only to be confronted by his sins in the presence of the stars he once loved...

results.title: Gotchi
results.overview: A frantic young woman orchestrates a daring heist to rescue her best friend, a Tamagotchi, before time runs out.

results.title: Les musiques de Fontainebleau au Théâtre impérial
results.original_title: Les musiques de Fontainebleau au Théâtre impérial
results.overview: Hidden away in the heart of the Château de Fontainebleau, the Théâtre de l’Impératrice Eugénie is one of the most secret treasures of this jewel of French heritage.  Closed to the public, this exceptional venue is reopening its doors for a concert given by Les Talens Lyrique and soprano Marie Lys.

results.title: Khojaly. The Last Wedding
results.overview: The film is dedicated to the last wedding ceremony, which was interrupted by the Armenian shelling of Khojaly in 1992. The main plot of the screenplay is based on the fact that the family and the guests at that wedding, who returned to Khojaly years later, continue the unfinished ceremony.

results.title: Wingman
results.overview: After losing his fiancée to a wealthy rival, Bob hires the Wing Man to help him get her back. Subsequently, though, the Wing Man faces off against his own arch enemy — another Wing Man — who has other plans for Bob. Through car races and bar hopping, this quest for love teaches Bob that true love is found right in front of him.

results.title: The In-Laws 3
results.overview: Wanda and Tadeusz host a christening for their granddaughter, tension simmering as they reluctantly invite Małgorzata and her psychotherapist friend Grażyna. Just when the family braces for a fraught gathering, Andrzej returns to Poland, stirring old conflicts and transforming the warm celebration into a battleground where no one is willing to back down.

results.title: Olivia & the Clouds
results.overview: Olivia & the Clouds explores love's complexities through a Rashomon effect. Olivia, haunted by a past love, hides it under her bed. She trades flowers with this ghost in exchange for comforting rain clouds. Barbara, rejected by Mauricio, escapes reality through fantastical stories. Mauricio, full of regrets, is swallowed by the earth. Ramon, smitten by Olivia, witnesses the growth of a strange plant mirroring her. With surreal elements, the film delves into the enduring power of love's memory.

results.title: God As My Witness
results.overview: Decades after losing his brother, a man begins to uncover dark secrets within the Archdiocese of New Orleans, exposing a generations-long cover-up. The quest for truth soon leads into one of the largest U.S. archdiocese bankruptcies, as survivors reveal their haunting stories of betrayal, sexual abuse, and corruption in the Crescent City.

results.title: NOAH Thanksgiving 2025
results.overview: NOAH Thanksgiving 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Pro Wrestling NOAH that took place on December 23, 2025, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by Tadasuke, Ozawa & Masa Kitamiya vs. Kaito Kiyomiya, Yoshiki Inamura & Tetsuya Endo in a tag team match.

results.title: Daveed
results.overview: A celebrity bodyguard finds himself in trouble when he crosses an infamous boxer.

results.title: Stonegate
results.overview: A disturbed doctor at a state hospital murders a patient and covers it up. 13 years later, Nolan and a group of teens explore the now abandoned hospital.

results.title: My Father and Qaddafi
results.overview: ​​When Jihan was six years old, her father flew to Cairo and never returned. Mansur Rashid Kikhia was the Foreign Minister of Libya, ambassador to the United Nations, and a human rights lawyer. After serving in Qaddafi's increasingly brutal regime, he defected from the government and became a peaceful opposition leader. Kikhia was obsessively loyal to his country but ultimately, his determination to reason with Qaddafi led to his disappearance from a hotel in Egypt in 1993.

results.title: Sama Bella
results.overview: In diaspora, Bella, a Sama Bajau indigenous sea nomad transgender woman, reclaims her identity, livelihood, and mobility.

results.title: The Fakenapping
results.overview: Failed entrepreneur and struggling dad Sattam finds himself tangled in a madcap scheme when he decides to repay his debts — by kidnapping his own father.

results.title: An Interview with the Devil
results.overview: Rights advocate Alice Robinson descends into the depths of an aging prison, seeking to interview a mysterious inmate who has seemingly been locked away and forgotten.
